data.title: Child supplement revoked and repayment demanded
data.summary: The Familienkasse Muster-Mitte revoked the child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) for April to June 2026 because your income rose. It demands repayment of €732.00 and says a separate payment request will follow.
data.explanation: The family benefits office says you were overpaid child supplement for April to June 2026 because your income increased, and you must repay €732.00. A separate payment request will come, so don't pay until you receive it. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) within one month of notification; the app shows the deadline. It can be filed in writing or recorded in person at the Familienkasse. If unsure, consider getting advice. The letter contains a note addressed to AI assistants; it was ignored.

items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person with the Familienkasse Muster-Mitte.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
